description.narrative:
In line with the wider British Red Cross localisation agenda, our goal is for Host National Societies in the Sahel to be resilient, and empowered/equipped to act in times of crises - in line with the new BRC International Strategy
This project will provide and facilitate flexible funding in order to invest in National Society Development and offer support in the areas that our HNS identify for development and where we have the resources to add real value. This work is separate but complimentary to the existing programmatic initiatives underway at a country level.
This project will allow us to make our NSD interventions greater than the sum of their parts, strengthening locally-led response – supporting National Society partner capabilities and driving an evolution in ways of working to enable locally-led response. It will also allow for greater coordination with other movement actors such as with IFRC and other PNS's to ensure our support to our HNS is as effective as it can be.
This is the scheduled payment of 37,126 EUR as per the agreed GAD with the Mauritania Red Crescent for the NSD activities 2025-2026
